name: Yamuna Shramdaan
gathering: Shramdaan means donated labour. People come to the river and do the unglamorous half of it — clearing, carrying, planting, going home dirty.

holes.what: We cannot tell you when a Yamuna Shramdaan last ran, how many have run, or which stretch of bank. Only that they have.
holes.unlocks: One line, and the Shramdaan archive folder.
